implemented_invariants.fact: Shared text masks, per-query masks, alpha logit fusion, and original mask losses are inherited.
Initialization disables A's nine coordinate channels.
Bincount measures input-member multiplicity; the helper does not deduplicate coordinates.
Detached fused mask logits determine hard foreground and extents; absent/degenerate extents retain the native prior.
One clamped gate per axis mixes center and size, coupling both faces on that axis.
Native winner selection is detached; score computation itself remains trainable through the ordinary network.
Any original last-layer matched query is excluded from C; preserving the matching algorithm does not freeze assignments.
Core native trainability and RoBERTa freezing are retained; C/G activation is read from the spec. Source presence does not attest execution.
Earlier G changes token loss on qualifying unmatched high-box-IoU queries and is separate inherited work.

claims.name: Candidate mask-state/count-conditioned residual
claims.delta: Before inherited alpha fusion, a candidate/superpoint residual uses native shared-text/own-query mask state and input-member count.
claims.specific_thinness: Small statistical conditioning added to an ordinary content-conditioned residual; coordinates are zero and specialized conditioning is not isolated.
claims.evidence_that_would_carry: The briefing's same-capacity content-only residual comparison supports a useful effect attributable to mask-state/count inputs.
claim_limits: No first residual mask refinement claim

claims.name: Extremal-source-conditioned per-axis interpolation
claims.delta: Gate inputs pair opposite-face tokens pooled from all tied superpoints that supply the actual hard mask extent.
claims.specific_thinness: Distinctive source selection is not shown useful by the +1/-1 whole-support contrast; fixed-half mixing passes the numerical target.
claims.evidence_that_would_carry: Benefit attributable to extremal evidence beyond the briefing's same-capacity whole-support and generic/constant gate controls.
claims.effectiveness_status: no demonstrated extremal-specific improvement in supplied contrast
claim_limits: No six independent face confidence estimates
No proof learned mixing is necessary

claims.name: Unmatched native winner root-mask supervision
claims.delta: At most one native highest-scoring root query receives its own/fused root-mask target only when absent from every existing match.
claims.specific_thinness: A narrow extra-positive rule in mixed-supervision literature; motivation overlaps inference-aware learning and no isolated normal-training C result is supplied.
claims.evidence_that_would_carry: The briefing's native-loss versus C contrast at fixed A/B, G, initialization, inference, and update budget establishes a useful effect.
claim_limits: No new score head or post-hoc selector
Matching algorithm is unchanged, assignments need not be identical
Joint score pathway is not globally frozen
